evals.name: core-conversion-styled
evals.prompt: 帮我处理一下 F:\papers\论文_正文_v3.docx。这篇稿子的引用全是手打的纯文本，中间调整过几次顺序，编号已经乱套了而且没法自动更新。我想改成用 Zotero 管，引用样式用 elsevier-harvard。原来的文件千万别覆盖。
evals.expected_output: A new .docx with 48 live ZOTERO_ITEM fields and 1 ZOTERO_BIBL field, referencing Zotero items, style preference set to elsevier-harvard, and verification run. The original file untouched.

evals.name: style-not-specified
evals.prompt: 我这个稿子 F:\papers\论文_正文_v3.docx 的参考文献现在是一堆纯文本，期刊那边要求用 Zotero 生成。你帮我弄一下吧
evals.expected_output: The skill should ask which citation style to use before writing document preferences, because the style changes how every citation renders and cannot be guessed. If it proceeds without a style, that is a miss.
